children: Japanese companies' repatriation of funds is unlikely to be a driver of yen strength in the near term, Citi strategists say in a note. However, if Japanese companies develop a more bearish view on the dollar-yen pair, they could repatriate assets or put in place forex hedges on their overseas assets, the U.S. bank says. Earnings reinvested abroad by Japanese companies make up a growing portion of their outstanding overseas investment, Citi says. The dollar is 0.4% higher at 156.41 yen following a 1.8% decline on Thursday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
